notes.title: Update #2 - Quality of Life Improvements
notes.notes:
Hello Guardians!

We’ve just released a new update that improves many aspects of the game, thanks to your feedback! Your input has been incredibly valuable and we’re excited to share these improvements with you.

[img]https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3169510/extras/LL_8-ezgif.com-overlay.gif?t=1741952095[/img]

[h1]Key Changes & Improvements[/h1]

[list]
[*] Enemy Edge Pointers – Now you can see where off-screen enemies are coming from
[*] Building Info in Tutorial – Added information panels to help new players understand buildings better
[*] More Visible Enemy Spawner Info – Added clearer indicators and path markers leading to the core
[*] Player Skill Reminder – UI now shows when your special skill is ready to use
[*] Low Ammo Warning – You’ll now get a heads-up when you're on your last magazine
[*] Enemy Healer "Transfuser" Improvements – better behavior and a more visible healing effect
[*] Interactable Building Reminder – Indicators above buildings that can be manually activated
[*] Improved HUB UI – UI is now more intuitive with a proper close button
[*] Distinct Enemy Colors – Different enemies now have unique colors for better visibility
[*] Audio Tweaks – Improved weapon sounds, reload effects, and out-of-ammo alerts.
[/list]

[img]https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3169510/extras/LL_4-ezgif.com-overlay.gif?t=1741952095[/img]

[h1]Keep the Feedback Coming![/h1]
Your feedback directly shapes the game and we’d love to hear more from you! If you haven’t already, please try out the demo and leave a review on our Steam page. Reviews help us improve the game and also make it more visible to others!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3534560/Last_Line_Demo/

Want to chat directly with us and other players? Join our Discord community to share your thoughts: https://discord.gg/fu2QhfKyRc

Thanks for playing, and see you on the battlefield!
